title: jasminocereus thouarsii subsp. sclerocarpus
intro: Jasminocereus thouarsii subsp. sclerocarpus, commonly known as the Night-Blooming Cereus, is a species of cactus known for its unique ability to bloom at night and close its flowers before dawn. The plant is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce oxidative stress and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Jasminocereus thouarsii subsp. sclerocarpus include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, which can aid in the treatment of various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been identified in the plant's leaves, stems, and roots.
